ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for the teeth PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for the teeth PRACTICES.

2. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

4. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only carbon dioxide

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Plants ENVIRONMENT.

7. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Foods/Feeding PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals ENVIRONMENT.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Home ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Home ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Home ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Home ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Home ENVIRONMENT.

11. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

12. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying : OUR SCHOOL? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on : OUR SCHOOL.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for : OUR SCHOOL.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about : OUR SCHOOL.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to : OUR SCHOOL.

14. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sanitation/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sanitation/ PRACTICES.

16. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hand washing PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hand washing PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Hand washing PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hand washing PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hand washing PRACTICES.

18. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

19. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.

21. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather ENVIRONMENT.
